column3: Close to the Hebrew; “a nation at ease” is rendered “the wealthy nation.”
Close to the Hebrew; “those who are cut off at the corner” is rendered “those in the farthest corners.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the beginning of their strength” is rendered “The foremost of their might.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will shatter Elam” is rendered “I will cause Elam to be dismayed.”
Close to the Hebrew; “turn back the captivity” is rendered “bring back the captives.”
